definitions: A field within cybersecurity that deals with real-time monitoring, correlation of events, and analysis of security alerts from network hardware and applications.
A software product or service that combines security information management (SIM) and security event management (SEM) functions into one security management system.
examples: Our company implemented a new security information and event management system to enhance threat detection.
Understanding security information and event management is crucial for modern cybersecurity professionals.
The audit highlighted the need for better security information and event management practices.
